contract: evolve_composition(initial_field, parameters, times) -> array (len(times),N,N). Integrate dc/dt=M*L[f'(c)-kappa*L(c)] using the specified second-order periodic discrete Laplacian on [0,200)^2; f=rho*(c-alpha)^2*(c-beta)^2 with alpha=.3,beta=.7,rho=5,M=5,kappa=2. Score candidate wall time only when RMSE<=2e-5 versus independent DOP853, mass drift<1e-9 and discrete free energy never increases. Two fixed meshes 48 and 64, published initial condition and a phase-shift adaptation, times 1,5,20. These are explicit short-horizon, fixed-mesh adaptations, not a reproduction of PFHub equilibrium results.
